sentences.text: On 1.31, a VolumeAttributesClass is used to provide the driver name and parameters when a PersistentVolume needs to be dynamically provisioned or modified.

citations.quote: Each VolumeAttributesClass contains the `driverName` and `parameters`, which are used when a PersistentVolume (PV) belonging to the class needs to be dynamically provisioned or modified.
